[[File:MandalorianPowerShield-KOTORrender.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mandalorian power shield]]
The '''Mandalorian power shield''' was developed by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorians]] as an upgraded version of their basic [[Mandalorian melee shield|forearm shield]] that offered additional defense against energy attacks as well as physical attacks. This device was said to have proved decisive for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in several battles with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and was still in widespread use during the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Dark Wars]]. Most [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] priced them at 1400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]] during this [[Time/Legends|time]].

It was very resistant to [[Blaster/Legends|small arms fire]] and even [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] may have used them.
